name: Abrucena (Spain)
description: Green field with a broad light yellow border, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Abrucena (a castle and a tree on green and yellow).
history: Authorised by the Junta de Andalucía in July 2002, the symbols were adopted in March 2007; the flag is a green rectangular cloth of proportions 1:1.5 edged with a light yellow border one sixth of the width of the cloth.

features.role: broad border one sixth of the width
